basis: On 2026-11-19 the project owner directed approval and publication of PR #185 security fingerprints for the refreshed Teyza membership site. The social-first sign-in retains secure access for existing email-only sellers behind a collapsed legacy disclosure, and links social identity through Firebase linkWithPopup on the original UID. Exact canonical LF and derived Windows CRLF SHA-256 fingerprints are pinned. The existing operator source-risk waiver is not a third-party malware-clean verdict.
scope: Only PR #185 website seller-membership UI and its Firebase web-auth JavaScript. Preserves server-confirmed Firebase UID, R99 calendar proration, Paystack return verification, checkout eligibility and order flow. Does not authorise unrelated Hosting or backend updates.
